A note for you, Layan ❤️

Dear Layan, my Gumball,

Happy birthday! I wanted to make you something that comes from me, so I built you this little world. I hope it made you smile.

I still think it's amazing that we met online. Two people on different sides of a screen became real friends. Talking to you makes my day better, and I'm really thankful for you.

We've known each other for 130 days now, and I'm grateful for every one of them.

I can't pick one special moment from our Roblox games, and I think that's because every game with you is fun in its own way. It was never about winning. It was about playing together.

We watched 10 Things I Hate About You together, and you told me you liked it. That made me really happy, and it made our movie night even better. Ten things I hate about you? I couldn't find even one.

You love Minions, SpongeBob, and Gumball, and I love that about you. It's why you'll always be Gumball to me. I hope you never stop being that happy, silly, one-of-a-kind person.

You're kind, you're funny, and you're so beautiful. I hope you know that every day, not just on your birthday.

I hope this year brings you everything you've been wishing for: lots of laughter, good news, and people who care about you.

I hope we have many more games, movies, and birthdays together. Thank you for being you.

Happy birthday, Layan.
With all my heart ❤️
Mamuka
